stem.en: 12 g of carbon combines with 32 g of oxygen to form 44 g of carbon dioxide. If 6 g of carbon reacts completely with enough oxygen, how many grams of carbon dioxide form?

explanation.en: Carbon dioxide has a fixed ratio, so 12 g of carbon always gives 44 g of carbon dioxide. 6 g is half of 12 g, so it gives half of 44 g, which is 22 g.

hints.en: 6 g is what fraction of 12 g? The carbon dioxide formed will be the same fraction of 44 g.
